title: BUG: Time Clock user's Work Order create is not blocked with 403 (should be blocked)
custom_preconds:
1. A user is signed in with the system Time Clock role (Work Orders View, Schedule View, Timesheets View; View Mode none; every other permission OFF; read-only, can clock in/out).
  2. You have a way to send API requests to the backend (api.staging.shopview.com) as that signed-in Time Clock user.
custom_steps: 1. Send POST /api/work-orders/create (with and without a valid company_id).
custom_expected:
EXPECTED: the request should return 403 Forbidden because the Time Clock role does not have Work Orders Create & Edit.

ACTUAL (2026-07-13, staging): it never returns 403 — it returns 400 ("company_id Missing required parameter") with a minimal body, and 500 with a valid company_id, i.e. the request is processed PAST the permission gate. No work order persisted in this probe, but the create endpoint is missing the permission gate.

Linked to the Jira bug: "BE — Time Clock Role Permissions Not Properly Enforced".
evidence: API live-probe 2026-07-13 (STAGING) as Time Clock role (be58f381): POST /api/work-orders/create -> expected 403, actual 400/500 (never 403) => LEAK-bug.
source: API — Time Clock Role Enforcement probe (Jira: BE Time Clock Role Permissions Not Properly Enforced)
